name: Long Term Interest-Free by HummGroup, New Zealand for WooCommerce
author: hummau

sections.description:
New Zealand – Q Card, Q Mastercard.

Meet the needs of your customers with a finance solution that provides your customers with access to Interest Free payment terms, from 6-months all the way up to 60-months.

Install this plug-in today and with our frictionless purchase experience you can convert more sales, increase your shopping cart size and, drive customer growth resulting in an overall better customer experience and customer outcome.

Our product website can be found here:

Q Card and Q Mastercard

You must have a merchant account with Humm-Group prior to installing the module.
Not yet a merchant partner? Contact us at: Apply to Become a Merchant Partner – Q Cards

The above is for merchant’s information only, and not to be shared further without the permission of Humm-Group.
sections.installation:
Pre-requisites

A working WooCommerce plugin (version >=3.0) installation

Other assumptions

You have received a valid Merchant ID, Login ID, Password, API Key and Payment Status API key from FlexiCards

Installation

  • Login to your WordPress Admin area
  • Go to “Plugins > Add New” from the left hand menu
  • In the search box type “Long Term Interest-Free by HummGroup”
  • From the search result you will see “Long Term Interest-Free by HummGroup” plugin click on “Install Now” to install the plugin
  • A popup window will ask you to confirm your wish to install the Plugin.
  • If successful, click “Activate Plugin” to activate it, or “Return to Plugin Installer” for further actions.

Manual Installation

*. Download the plugin zip file
*. Login to your WordPress Admin. Click on “Plugins > Add New” from the left hand menu.
*. Click on the “Upload” option, then click “Choose File” to select the zip file from your computer. Once selected, press “OK” and press the “Install Now” button.
*. Activate the plugin.
*. Open the Settings page for WooCommerce and click the “Payment” tab.
*. Click on the “Q Card & Q Mastercard Interest Free” method.
*. Configure your “Q Card” settings. See below for details.

After configuring and activating the Q Card plugin, you should see the “Q Card & Q Mastercard Interest-Free” payment option on your store checkout.

This Plugin is available in New Zealand

Please refer to the User/Installation Guide
